description: The file defines the 'MetadataModel' class and related structures used in the Orleans code generation project, specifically handling serialization types, interfaces, proxies, type aliases, and type trees for code generation purposes.

classes.name: MetadataModel
classes.description: Represents the data model for serialization, proxies, interfaces, and types used during Orleans code generation.

classes.name: CompoundTypeAliasTree
classes.description: A prefix tree (trie) structure for managing compound type aliases, supporting add and retrieval operations.

classes.name: CompoundTypeAliasComponent
classes.description: A struct representing a component of a compound type alias, encapsulating string or type symbol.

classes.name: Either<T, U>
classes.description: A generic discriminated union structure to hold either a value of type T or type U.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a root node of the CompoundTypeAliasTree with no key or value.

methods.name: GetChildOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a child node by key, or null if not found.

methods.name: TryGetChild
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a child node by key, returning true if successful.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a series of components as a path in the compound alias tree with an associated TypeSyntax value.

methods.name: AddInternal
methods.description: Internal method to add a node to the tree with a key and optional value.
